title: Skillpack tool registry
description: Registry of local agent tools a Skillpack skill can be installed into (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok Bot (Cursor's desktop assistant), OpenClaw, Hermes, …). The single, extensible source of truth for each tool's on-disk skill directories.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema for editor validation.

tools.description: Map of tool key (kebab-case, e.g. "claude-code") to its install spec.

detect.description: Paths whose existence indicates the tool is present on this machine. Any match counts as detected. A path may start with `~` for the home directory and may begin with a `${VAR:-fallback}` segment (non-empty fallback) that prefers an environment variable, for example "${AGENT_STATE_DIR:-~/.companions}/pi/skills"; the resolved user path must be absolute.

skillsDir.description: Where this tool reads skills, by scope.

user.description: User-global skills directory, e.g. "~/.claude/skills", "~/.agents/skills", "~/.cursor/skills", "~/.openclaw/skills", or "${AGENT_STATE_DIR:-~/.companions}/pi/skills". Supports `~` and a leading `${VAR:-fallback}` segment (non-empty fallback); the resolved path must be absolute.

project.description: Optional project-relative skills directory, e.g. ".claude/skills", ".agents/skills", ".cursor/skills", or "skills" (joined under a repo or workspace root). Omit it when a tool only has a global source of truth.

recursive.description: Whether onboarding discovery should find skill folders recursively below the registered roots. Use this for tools such as Hermes that organize skills in category subdirectories.

format.description: Package format the tool consumes. "skill-md" installs the package as-is; other values select a future format adapter.
